root.source: same-tick PlanningEvidenceFrame and source-backed verified route experience
root.candidate_consequence_rule: candidate branches may change option status only; they may not create, delete, rename, or reorder root options

known_weak_continuation_option.semantic: one concrete recovery continuation established as possible by lived/source-backed evidence
known_weak_continuation_option.modality: MAY remains MAY and is never promoted to MUST

status_semantics.PRESERVED: Every supported immediate candidate-effect branch retains at least one exact source-permitted matching continuation.
status_semantics.DESTROYED: Every supported immediate branch categorically invalidates the exact known option through an authoritative source condition; this does not claim that all recovery is impossible.
status_semantics.UNKNOWN: Any mixed branch outcome, uncertain applicability, missing evidence, or unknown candidate effect prevents a categorical conclusion.
status_semantics.elimination: UNKNOWN cannot eliminate; A may eliminate B only for the same root option set when A is PRESERVED, B is DESTROYED, no converse loss exists, and no asymmetric UNKNOWN exists.

source_horizon.semantics: frame-relative support horizon for the exact opportunity
source_horizon.unknown_rule: unknown or non-categorical horizon yields UNKNOWN

recovery_slack.definition: owner-local time-to-constitutional-viable-boundary minus exact known option demand
recovery_slack.recompute: after every supported immediate candidate branch

epistemic_rules.observed_duration: known witnessed demand, not a universal future guarantee
